menumobs.configgui.title: Menu Mobs Config
menumobs.config.showMainMenuMobs.tooltip: Show your logged-in player and a random mob on the main menu. Set to false to disable.
menumobs.config.showOnlyPlayerModels.too: Only show random player models on the main menu instead of mobs.
menumobs.config.mobSoundVolume.tooltip: Volume (0.0 - 1.0) used for the ambient sounds mobs make on the main menu.
menumobs.config.fixedMob.tooltip: List of entity ids (or player names) which will be shown on the main menu. Empty = random.
menumobs.config.blacklist.tooltip: Entity ids that will never be shown on the main menu.
menumobs.config.allowDebugOutput.tooltip: Print debug messages about the currently shown entity to the log.
menumobs.config.showMenuButtons.tooltip: Show the small 'add to blacklist' and 'next entity' buttons on the top left of the main menu.
